about: A large library of ready-made helper functions for Go.

prs.title: Newer Mastercard numbers pass the check
prs.broken: The Mastercard check only knew the old 51 to 55 prefixes, so it rejected every card starting with 2221 to 2720, issued since 2017.
prs.changed: The check now accepts the 2-series range too.
prs.matters: Checkouts built on it no longer refuse valid Mastercards.

prs.title: Counting days across a clock change gives the right number
prs.broken: Counting the days between two dates came out one day short when the range crossed the spring clock change, because that day only has 23 hours.
prs.changed: It now compares calendar dates and times, so a short day still counts as a day.
prs.matters: Date math in apps using it is no longer off by one in March.

prs.title: Zipping a folder reports errors from subfolders
prs.broken: Zipping a folder returned success but left files out when something in a subfolder could not be read, such as a linked folder or a locked file.
prs.changed: Errors from subfolders are now returned instead of being dropped.
prs.matters: A zip that looks done really holds every file, or you are told why not.
